description: The pie chart, titled "Distribution of Difficulty," illustrates the proportion of items across five difficulty levels: Very easy, Easy, Medium, Hard, and Very hard. The largest segment, colored red, represents "Medium" difficulty, accounting for 51.8% of the total. The second largest, in blue, is "Hard" at 25.7%. "Easy" difficulty, shown in green, makes up 11.2% of the distribution. The "Very hard" category, in orange, comprises 6.5%, and the smallest segment, "Very easy" in purple, accounts for 4.8%. The legend on the top left correlates each difficulty level with its corresponding color and numerical count, with "Medium" having 725,892 items, "Hard" 360,137, "Easy" 157,053, "Very hard" 91,576, and "Very easy" 65,332. The percentages are labeled directly on the chart next to each slice.
